boundedQuestion: Can the same isotropic corrosion field avoid grid-axis-dependent top-versus-side deformation before any exposure-direction term is introduced?
hypothesis: A boundary-aware partial-area-centroid discretization should reduce orientation spread relative to cell-center quadrature without changing the corrosion-field semantics.
requiredChecks: same delta, kappa and m for all schemes
sweep wave-vector direction from 0 through 90 degrees
report normalized orientation spread for FA, PA_HHB and PA_AC
PA_AC spread lower than FA and at least 20x smaller at the pinned audition parameters
mustNotClaim: steel plate, lock or AC housing production transfer passed
